problem_framing: Develop a model to predict the propensity of existing customers to convert to a new credit card product within the next month, given their transaction history and product holdings.

windows.oot_rationale: The latest two months (2025-05 and 2025-06) are selected as out-of-time (OOT) snapshots to evaluate the model's performance on unseen, future data, ensuring robustness and generalizability.

rationale: Given the severe class imbalance (5.03% positive rate) and the dataset size, Gradient Boosting Machines (LightGBM and XGBoost) are chosen for their ability to handle complex interactions and their robustness. These algorithms will be configured with `scale_pos_weight` to address the imbalance, and feature scaling will be applied to optimize their performance.
